Workshop: Hand-Authoring and Generating a TEI Critical Apparatus

Overview: In this workshop, you will encode a 25-line critical edition of your primary witness collated against two additional witnesses. You will author positive apparatus entries by hand, verify that every witness sigil resolves to a <listWit> entry in your TEI header, and visualize your edition in the TEI Critical Apparatus Toolbox.

Deadlines: Comparison Post due Friday by 11:00 PM; Peer Reviews due Monday by 11:00 PM.
